create_variables_network: create variables for a Sonnet module by running a forward pass with dummy inputs
add_batch_dim_nested: add a batch dimension to each leaf of a nested structure of TensorFlow tensors
batch_concat_tensors: concatenate a nested collection of tensors while preserving the batch dimension
to_sonnet_module_callable: convert an arbitrary tensor-valued callable into a Sonnet module wrapper
tile_nested_tensors: tile tensors in a nested structure along a new leading axis multiple times
